_om: UI strings and field names in English. Numbers never live here - they live in data/robots/*.yaml. A missing key fails the build. This is the only place English UI text lives: the generator’s fallback files were retired on 21 Aug 2026.
sted_undertitel: A reference work with a source and a date on every number
ingen_forhandler: We do not resell any robot on this site, and we take no payment from the manufacturers.
forside_lede: {n} models from {p} manufacturers. Every figure carries a source and a retrieval date, and every gap is as visible as the figure.
forside_ordning: Ordered by weight, because weight is measured and unambiguous. Intended use is a filter, not an axis.
katalog_soeg_etiket: Search by model, manufacturer or requirement
katalog_soeg_pladsholder: e.g. Spot, DEEP Robotics or IP67
yderpunkter_forklaring: {n} measured facts from the catalogue – not a selection and not a recommendation. The heaviest robot is not better than the lightest; it is simply heaviest.
forside_eu_paastand: robots in the catalogue state CE marking from the manufacturer.
forside_afslutning_saetning: The catalogue holds all {n} robots from {p} manufacturers – the same source and retrieval date on every figure, none singled out as the best.
katalog_sortering_forklaring: Sorting orders the cards within each weight class. The weight classes themselves always stay in the same order, so a card never moves to another hall. Works without JavaScript.
sammenligning_lede: Choose 2 or 3 robots to compare them field by field. Every field from the schema stands in the same order as on the robot page.
sammenligning_vaelg_forklaring: Choose 2 or 3 robots from the list. The table updates automatically.
sammenligning_maks: You can compare at most 3 robots at a time.
sammenligning_for_faa: Choose at least 2 robots to see the comparison.
sammenligning_uden_js_forklaring: The comparison requires JavaScript. Without it: pick a robot from the list to see its full specification.
sammenligning_uden_js_noscript: Side-by-side comparison requires JavaScript. The catalogue shows the robots' key figures without JavaScript.
sammenligning_legende_vinder_forklaring: We do not mark a winning cell per row. A lower value is not better than a higher one – only the intended use decides that, and the page does not know the use.
katalog_uden_js: The full catalogue is in the table below even with JavaScript switched off.
filter_uden_js: Ticks in the same group widen the selection, ticks across groups narrow it. The filters work without JavaScript.
filter_ingen_traef: No robots match this combination of filters. Remove one filter and results will come back.
filter_omfang_statisk: A filter is on. The figures beside the filters and the halls count the whole catalogue – not the selection shown below. A hall with no cards has no robots that match.
vaegtklasse_forklaring: The class boundaries are set in the build, not in the data. The manufacturer’s own qualifier stays with the figure: a robot stated as at most 20 kg sits in 20–40 kg, because 20 is the number the manufacturer prints.
vaegtklasse_ikke_oplyst_forklaring: The manufacturer states no weight at all. These sit here, not hidden at the bottom of another class.
vaegtklasse_afledt: Derived from the stated unladen weight. The manufacturer does not state a class.
vaegtklasse_graense: the figure sits on the class boundary, and the manufacturer’s qualifier could move it
noegletal_titel: Key figures as stated by the manufacturer
noegletal_afvigelser: Deviations and variants in the key figures ({n})
noegletal_intet: The manufacturer states none of the {b} key figures.
noegletal_intet_alle: The manufacturer states none of the {b} key figures.
noegletal_intet_grund: The cells are not empty by mistake. There is no manufacturer page carrying the figures.
tilstand_ikke_oplyst_forklaring: The manufacturer states nothing about this field.
tilstand_nej_forklaring: The manufacturer states that the robot does not have this.
tilstand_nul_forklaring: The manufacturer states the value zero. That is a measured number, not an empty field.
tilstand_kun_billede_forklaring: The information can be seen in the manufacturer’s photo but is written nowhere.
foraeldet: Retrieved more than 12 months ago – may be wrong now.
kilder_forklaring: One line per source, not per figure: a source has one retrieval date. The letter beside a figure points to the line it came from.
tegnforklaring_oplyst: The manufacturer states a figure with a unit.
kilde_maerke_forklaring: A superscript letter after a figure points to the source the figure came from. Robots with several sources carry several letters.
kilde_sek_forklaring: A dashed letter marks a secondary source on the manufacturer’s own domain – a datasheet, manual or developer documentation, not the product page.
kilde_antal_en: The figures on this card come from 1 source
kilde_antal_flere: The figures on this card come from {n} sources – see the marks
kort_kilder_en: The figures on this card come from 1 source
kort_kilder_flere: The figures on this card come from {n} sources – see the marks
kort_kilder_ingen: None of the figures on this card carry a source in the data file.
kort_legende: Card photos are the manufacturers’ own. Card figures carry source marks – a superscript letter points to which source a figure comes from.
enhed_skift_forklaring: Imperial figures are our own conversion and carry the mark "converted". Figures without that mark are the manufacturer’s own. The source letter always belongs to the metric figure — a conversion has no source of its own.
enhed_omregnet_forklaring: Our conversion from {figur}. The manufacturer does not state an imperial figure itself, so the conversion has no source of its own.
taethed_forklaring: How many of the schema’s fields the manufacturer itself states. It measures the manufacturer’s openness, not the robot’s quality.
taethed_naevner: Out of the schema’s {b} fields. The same denominator for every robot.
skema_tabel_forklaring: The letter points to the source at the foot of the page. Fields without a figure are dashed: the manufacturer does not state them — that is not the same as zero, and not the same as no.
sammenlign_advarsel: Stair step and payload each exist in two variants. Only compare fields with the same label.
anvendelse_forklaring: This category is not our assessment. It is the manufacturer’s own classification, quoted verbatim. Where the manufacturer cannot be quoted, it reads not stated.
anvendelse_arvet_fra: Category inherited from the base model
anvendelse_arvet_forklaring: The manufacturer says nothing about this edition. The quote below is the base model’s, and the link between the two is ours.
anvendelse_forklaring_arvet: The words are the manufacturer’s, but they were written about the base model. That they also cover this edition is our inference – which is why it is marked.
eu_forklaring: The field shows only what the manufacturer states about CE marking. It is a record of fact, not import advice.
eu_ce_nej: The manufacturer states that there is no CE marking
eu_pointe: {n} of {m} manufacturers say nothing about CE. The silence is the finding – it is not a gap in our collection.
varianter_forklaring: The manufacturer sells this model in several variants. The figures on this page apply to the variant the source names.
produktside_forklaring: We are not a dealer. The link goes to the manufacturer so the figures above can be checked at the source.
produktside_ingen: The manufacturer has no product page for this model, or it has been taken down.
robotside_midlertidig: This page is built with the generator’s temporary robot template. The real template is being written.
producent_ingen_modeller: No models from this manufacturer are in the catalogue yet.
billede_delt_forklaring: Same file as {model}. The manufacturer’s own choice – the photo is not necessarily this model.
billede_ingen_egen: We have not photographed this model ourselves, and the manufacturer does not have a usable image of this particular variant.
billede_ingen_grund: We have not photographed this model ourselves, and the manufacturer has no usable image of it.
billede_ophav_silhuet: Scale silhouette, drawn from the manufacturer’s own dimensions. Not a photograph.
billede_alt_silhuet: Scale silhouette of {model}, drawn from the manufacturer’s own dimensions
forside_udvalg_regel: {n} robots, spread across manufacturer and weight class and then selected by how many of the {m} fields the manufacturer states.
producent_fordeling_saetning: {n} of {m} manufacturers are from {land} and account for {x} of the {y} models in the catalogue.
kilde_original_form: The manufacturer wrote: {figur}. We show the figure in the site’s shared unit.
